title: Claude Opus 4.7: Anthropic's Flagship Coding and Reasoning Model
summary: Claude Opus 4.7 is Anthropic's most advanced flagship model, designed for high-level reasoning and autonomous software engineering. It is generally available via API and major cloud providers, featuring adaptive thinking modes for complex problem-solving.
research_notes: Features 3x higher vision resolution and is optimized for delegated engineering workflows through Claude Code.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 as the successor to Opus 4.6, this version introduced the 'xhigh' reasoning effort level and reached 64.3% on SWE-bench Pro. It currently serves as the GA flagship while the restricted 'Claude Mythos' frontier model undergoes safety verification.
